newsitem.title: USA: Versa Tech unit gets significant order.
newsitem.headline: Versa Tech unit gets significant order.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc said Wednesday its Power Gear division in Beaver Dam, Wis., entered into an agreement with a large manufacturer of recreational vehicles to supply slide-out room mechanisms for travel trailers.

The initial production phase has begun with volume increasing during the next several months. Full production is expected by the end of the fourth quarter of the fiscal year ending March 31. Estimated annual sales volume at full production is more than $6 million, it said.
